ios.desc:
Pixel Journal is a minimalist bullet journaling app designed for productivity enthusiasts, bullet journal users, and minimalists. It combines the flexibility of the analog Bullet Journal method with the convenience of digital planning. Guided by the Bullet Journal method's mission to help you be mindful of how you spend your time and energy, Pixel Journal lets you accomplish more by working on less - so you can focus on what is meaningful by stripping away the clutter.

With a clean, distraction-free interface, Pixel Journal eliminates unnecessary clutter and empowers you to stay focused and productive. Its clutter-free design creates an environment conducive to productivity, allowing you to concentrate on your tasks without distraction. Whether you're tracking habits, jotting down tasks, or reflecting on gratitude, Pixel Journal serves as your all-in-one planner, diary, and habit tracker - like a life coach in your pocket helping you reach your goals.

Key Features:
- Daily Logs & Tasks: Organize your day with a simple bullet journal system. Quickly jot down tasks, events, and notes in organized daily logs, so nothing important slips through the cracks. Writing everything down in an organized way also takes away the stress of trying to remember it all - less stress, more clarity.
- Custom Logs: Create your own journal sections (collections) to suit your life. Whether it's a project planner, mood tracker, or fitness log, custom logs let you tailor Pixel Journal to your needs, making your planning system truly personal.
- Habit Tracker: Build better habits with a dedicated habit tracker. Mark off your daily routines and visualize your progress over time. Habit trackers can help you learn more about your patterns and tendencies, motivating you to stay consistent and improving your self-discipline.
- Gratitude Log: Cultivate a positive mindset by recording things you're grateful for each day. A gratitude journal isn't just for reflection - research shows it can boost your alertness and reduce stress, which in turn makes you happier and more productive. Watch your outlook on life improve as you regularly practice gratitude.
- Themes & Colors: Personalize your journal with beautiful, calming themes and color options. Match Pixel Journal's look to your style - whether you prefer soothing neutrals or a pop of color. (Unlock all themes and additional color palettes with Pixel Journal Pro.)
